persona: Mid-level bank contact centre executive with a few gaps
resumeText:
Ayesha Khan | Hyderabad | ayesha.khan@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Customer Service Executive, Phone Banking, Golconda Unity Bank, Hyderabad (2023 - present)
- Handled 80 to 100 inbound customer calls a day on card and savings account queries.
- Resolved complaints on failed transactions, card charges and statement errors on the first call where possible.
- Met AHT and CSAT targets for 10 straight months in the phone banking team.
- Raised and tracked service requests in the bank's CRM.
- Explained card charges and EMI options to customers in English, Hindi and Telugu.
- Verified KYC documents for address and mobile number update requests.

Customer Support Associate, Kirana Kart Online, Hyderabad (2021 - 2023)
- Answered order and delivery questions over chat and email for an online grocery store.
- Processed return and refund requests within the returns policy.

EDUCATION
BCom, Osmania University, 2021

SKILLS
CRM, escalation handling, MS Excel
